summary.text: Javier Cervantes, a Democrat, represents the 1st District in the Illinois Senate; according to his office biography he was appointed in fall 2022 and re-elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: The biography describes him as a lifelong South Side Chicago resident with roots in the Pilsen neighborhood.

It says he studied at the International Academy of Design and Technology and the University of Illinois Chicago School of Labor, and worked for 12 years as a union representative with SEIU Health Care Illinois and Indiana before becoming a nursing home division coordinator.
